materialien.dachbahn: Old medium-dark graphite grey mineral-surfaced roofing felt on a low industrial flat roof. Dense fine slate granules, a few broad overlapping parallel strips with subtly offset end laps, subtle sun-fading. Full surface has fairly even brightness.
materialien.dachblech: Weathered industrial standing-seam roof, subdued neutral graphite/zinc grey metal. Dry matte, minimal reflectivity with no highlight stripes.

wechselbruecken.prompt: Create a square UV texture atlas for the GHP swap bodies in these two photographs. Each strip is one completely flat, straight-on full side of a taut coated truck curtain, lit evenly for a base-color map. Upper strip deep ultramarine royal blue, lower strip distinctly faded petrol cyan blue with age streaks as in the references. In each strip the left half carries the bold yellow GHP logo with two curved speed lines and the precise small wording ‘Spedition & Lagerei’ underneath. In the right half yellow hand-painted italic lettering on two lines reads ‘Transportkapazität’ and ‘nach Maß’, with fine yellow horizontal rules. Leave enough blue around each group so the two halves can change places. Wide artwork compressed into square texture coordinates for stretching onto two separate 7.4 by 2.6 metre sides. Subtle vertical PVC folds and welded seam lines. Only printed curtain material, no floor, sky, perspective, neighbors, borders, buckles, poles, vehicles or people.
